newsitem.title: USA: BISYS says Horizon pact ends, sees charges.
newsitem.headline: BISYS says Horizon pact ends, sees charges.

text.p: BISYS Group Inc said that the Pacific Horizon Funds elected to terminate the distribution and administration agreements with two of its units effective September 1997.
The action is expected to have a negative impact on the company's growth in earnings for fiscal year 1998 in the range of $0.15 per share, before one-time charges to re-align operations, BISYS said.
The Funds are proprietary mutual funds of Bank of America which serves as investment advisor, BISYS said.
The Funds provided no specific reasons for the terminations, BISYS said.

"We are shocked and deeply disappointed by the actions of the Fund's Board of Directors, especially given our long and successful relationship," said Lynn J. Mangum, chairman and chief executive officer of BISYS.
For fiscal year 1997, revenues related to the agreements accounted for about $15 million, BISYS said.
The company believes the terminations are not indicative of its capabilities as a leading provider of services to bank proprietary mutual funds.
